Nina (AE): Stonegate wants a 5-day POC for a customer-tuned 'cedar-30b' variant. Requirements: private deploy (VPC+KMS), p95 <=140ms @~1k tokens, embedding throughput 150 qps, and a ballpark price. Can we preflight?
Omar (Solutions): Checklist: model compat (kv, tokenizer), quant recommend, sizing (dedicated vs burst), fallback plan. Do they have token distribution?
Nina (AE): Yes — median 600, 95th 1.2k, rare 2.5k. They'll upload sample prompts later today.
Priya (ML): Cedar-30b notes: custom tokenizer merges possible. I'll run quick compat scan: `rwd-compat --model cedar-30b-cust --checks tokenizer,kv,ops`. If kv>48GB we suggest q4_0. ETA ~1h.
Marco (Infra): Need KMS ARN + VPC CIDRs. For reserved 3-GPU pool estimate ~$11k/mo; will confirm SKU. If they want SLA add-on we need committed capacity.
Sam (Security): Send vendor questionnaire. If HSM required add 2-3wk onboarding.
Nina (AE): Great — I'll request weights + prompt set and share link.
